base: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one original professional interior photograph for a Japanese cleaning company website. Landscape 3:2 framing. Natural real photography, physically plausible details, modest everyday commercial premises in Japan, neutral whites with subdued blue accents, soft natural light, realistic materials. No people, human body parts or silhouettes, including mirrors and reflections. No illustration, anime, CGI look, text, logos, labels or watermark. Show a setting different from the reference site while keeping the named cleaning subject clear. No montage or contact sheet.

scenes.aircon: A recessed four-way commercial ceiling air conditioner viewed diagonally upward inside a small empty office meeting room. The complete white grille and ceiling unit are clearly visible, with a corner of a light wood conference table at the bottom. Clean air vents, restrained realistic office ceiling, not a close-up of a worker cleaning.
scenes.carpet: An empty contemporary small meeting lounge with navy-gray carpet tiles, a few neatly tucked chairs and a low oak meeting table. Frame low across the clean carpet to emphasize its fine fiber texture and straight tile seams. Bright daylight from side windows, no screens or personal belongings.
scenes.sanitizing: An empty office kitchenette worktop after hygiene cleaning. A plain unlabeled spray bottle and folded blue microfiber cloth beside a clean stainless steel sink and faucet, tiled backsplash, realistic small shared workplace setting. No spraying cloud, no people, no protective suits.
scenes.floor: A freshly cleaned vacant commercial unit ready for handover, warm gray hard flooring, white walls, large side windows and a simple entrance door. Low diagonal composition across a clean floor with gentle natural reflections. No desks or people, no construction debris, different from a large office reference photo.
scenes.glass: Close diagonal interior view of a spotless office sliding window and aluminum sash track, daylight through the clear glass, soft view of greenery beyond. Make clean glass edges and sash detail prominent. No skyline landmarks, no people or reflections of people.
scenes.lighting: An office ceiling with clean slim rectangular LED lighting fixtures, white acoustic ceiling panels and subtle beams. Upward diagonal architectural photograph, fixture details clearly visible, naturally exposed highlights, no people.
scenes.hood: A compact commercial kitchen stainless steel extraction hood above a clean cooking station, diagonal close view showing the hood's underside and filter panels. Natural brushed-metal texture, no brand, no people, no restaurant food or flames.
scenes.kitchen: An empty small commercial preparation kitchen, stainless steel work table, clean inset sink and organized unbranded cooking equipment. Frame a diagonal view across the polished but realistically textured work surfaces. No people or food styling.
scenes.shower: An empty small staff changing-room shower area with a clean chrome shower head, white-gray tiles, clear glass partition and simple drain. A calm realistic photo of the cleaned equipment, not a luxury bath advertisement. No people in glass reflections.
scenes.toilet: A clean modest commercial restroom cubicle with a white toilet, pale gray wall tile and simple paper holder. A diagonal doorway view, realistic proportions, neutral daylight-like lighting, no people or text.
scenes.hallway: A clean empty office corridor meeting a short stairway, neutral wall paint, brushed metal handrail and gray floor. Architectural diagonal photograph emphasizing tidy floor edges and stair treads, no people, no signs or lettering.
scenes.basin: A clean shared office washroom counter with two white basins and chrome faucets, soft natural lighting, pale tile and a large plain mirror. Photograph at an angle that avoids showing any person or camera reflection. Clearly visible clean sink surfaces, no labels.
scenes.balcony: A tidy modest commercial building balcony with a clean concrete floor, simple metal railing and a sliding glass door, soft morning daylight and ordinary greenery outside. Low diagonal view emphasizing clean floor and drainage edges, no people, no landmarks.
